from scipy.stats import norm

df = dataset[

].dropna()

df["paste_height_um"] = pd.to_numeric(
    df["paste_height_um"]
)

phases = sorted(df["phase"].unique())

fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    1, len(phases),
    figsize=(5 * len(phases), 4),
    squeeze=False
)

for ax, phase in zip(axes[0], phases):
    x = np.sort(
        df.loc[
            df["phase"] == phase,
            "paste_height_um"
        ].to_numpy()
    )

    n = len(x)
    p = (np.arange(1, n + 1) - 0.5) / n

    mu = np.mean(x)
    sd = np.std(x, ddof=1)

    theoretical = norm.ppf(p, loc=mu, scale=sd)

    ax.scatter(theoretical, x, s=8, alpha=0.6)

    limits = [
        min(theoretical.min(), x.min()),
        max(theoretical.max(), x.max())
    ]

    ax.plot(limits, limits, "--")

    ax.set_title(f"Q-Q Plot: {phase}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles (µm)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Observed Quantiles (µm)")
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()'
